title: encoder action
description: Converts the body from one charset to another: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, US-ASCII or windows-1252. Characters the target cannot hold become ?.

originCharset.title: Origin charset
originCharset.description: Charset of the body: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 (ISO8859_1), US-ASCII or windows-1252 (CP1252); not case sensitive

targetCharset.title: Target charset
targetCharset.description: Charset to convert the body to: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 (ISO8859_1), US-ASCII or windows-1252 (CP1252); not case sensitive
